anomalies.observed: On the NAVC Peripherals sheet the IIS2MDCTR magnetometer U8 has its SCL/SPC pin (4) wired to net I2C4_SCL_NAVC and its SDA/SDI/SDO pin (5) wired to net I2C4_SDA_NAVC. These two nets appear only on U8: no pin of NAVC1 (STM32F405RGTx) carries an I2C4 label (the MCU exposes I2C1 on PB6/PB7, I2C2 on PB8-PB11 and I2C3 on PA8/PA9), and the I2C pull-up network on the NAVC sheet (R28-R31, 4k7) pulls up only I2C1_*_NAVC and I2C2_*_NAVC. Every other NAVC sensor (BMI088 U5, TMP100 U6, MPRLS U7, EEPROM U9) is on I2C1_*_NAVC.
anomalies.expected: The magnetometer must sit on the same I2C sensor bus as the other NAVC peripherals (I2C1_*_NAVC, which has both the MCU master and the 4k7 pull-ups R28/R29). The STM32F405 has no I2C4 peripheral, so an I2C4_*_NAVC net cannot be driven by the MCU and, lacking pull-ups, cannot function as an I2C bus at all.

evidence.quote: NAVC Peripherals sheet: U8 IIS2MDCTR pin 4 = 'I2C4_SCL_NAVC', pin 5 = 'I2C4_SDA_NAVC'; U5/U6/U7/U9 pins = 'I2C1_SCL_NAVC'/'I2C1_SDA_NAVC'; pull-ups R28-R31 4k7 on I2C1/I2C2 only; NAVC1 = 'STM32F405RGTx'
Component table: 'Magnetometer | NAVCPeripherals | ST IIS2MDCTR, I2C addr 0x1E'; §4: '3V3 feeds both MCUs (FCC, NAVC) and all I2C sensor ICs'

anomalies.impact: The magnetometer's I2C lines connect to a net that reaches no MCU pin and has no pull-ups, so U8 can never be addressed; the heading/magnetic data required by the navigation solution is lost (the INT_MAG_NAVC interrupt line is still wired to PA6, confirming the device was meant to be active).

parsed.summary: The power stage, INA219 sense path, both MCUs, the FCC/NAVC link and the documented barometer RESET/EOC swap all match the specification; the one deviation I can read off the drawing is that the IIS2MDCTR magnetometer U8 is tied to an I2C4_*_NAVC net that the STM32F405 does not have and that has no pull-ups, unlike every other NAVC sensor which is on I2C1, leaving the magnetometer disconnected from the bus.
